facts.fact: Articles 20 to 25 of Loi n° 2017-020 (Journal Officiel no. 1400, dated 22 July 2017) bar a data controller from transferring personal data to a third country unless it ensures a sufficient level of protection, with exceptions for one-off non-massive transfers on express consent or on stated necessity, and with authorisation by the data protection authority (APD) on guarantees such as contract clauses; the document is the enacted text and gives no repeal.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

note: Fact dated to the law's date; the extract is truncated at article 71 and says nothing on whether the APD has published a country list or been applied, so no fact on the use aspect.
